title: PredictionRecord
description: Wire contract for one append-only prediction, written at creation time by the liddar-terminal app and read by the selflearn-core scorer. Mirrors selflearn_core.types.Prediction (and the predictions table in store/schema.sql). features.breadth is the regime stamp derived from the terminal's /api/breadth payload; it is OPTIONAL because breadth can be unavailable (the terminal omits it rather than fabricating it).

id.description: uuid; primary key in the predictions table

ts.description: unix seconds, prediction time. The no-lookahead boundary: everything in features must be knowable at ts.

task.description: 'scanner' | 'power_h1' | ... open-ended; identifies which adapter produced the record.

features.description: Point-in-time features known at ts. May carry a breadth regime stamp.

prediction.description: The prediction payload (direction/price/etc.). For task='scanner' this is a scanner idea.

horizon_s.description: seconds until the prediction is resolvable

cohort.description: ticker / ISO / regime bucket for scoring splits

breadth.description: RSP/SPY breadth regime at ts. Lets the scorer split hit-rate/return by regime (the 'stick with the wave' thesis, made measurable). All four values come from /api/breadth: direction, and last vs dma50/dma200.
